AccessDenied.description: IAM permissions issue - the credentials don't have required permissions
solutions: Check IAM policies attached to your user/role
Verify you're using the correct AWS profile with --profile
Refresh your AWS credentials if using temporary credentials
Check resource-based policies (e.g., S3 bucket policies)

InvalidParameterValue.description: One or more parameters have invalid values
solutions: Check parameter format in command documentation
Verify parameter values are within acceptable ranges
Verify the resource ID is correct
Check if resource exists in the AWS Console
Ensure you're in the correct region with --region
Confirm you're using the correct AWS account

common_causes: Too many API calls in short time
solutions: Request service quota increase if needed
